stop_rule: No higher N after unresolved convergence/quality failure or projected same-family solve>=10s; no repeat when single solve>=8s; hard watchdog10s; missing result NOT_RUN or TIME_BUDGET_EXCEEDED.
synthetic: One contiguous nearly touching simple-cubic lattice, 0.001R initial overlap; deterministic weak isotropic compression free=-1*(x-centroid) s^-1; same radius, no independent replicated subclusters. Benchmark only, no acoustics/CFD claim.
